gates.quadratic_mapping: whole-reference-triangle determinant polynomial minimum with floating-point guard, no sampled-proof claim

diagnosis: all saved failures, full corner/midside/connectivity/one-ring geometry and source feature context; immutable source angles checked before remediation

candidates.purpose: bounded optimization diagnostic on saved local patches
candidates.scope: worst interior and boundary-corner defect patches; never report cropped diagnostic as full specimen
candidates.full_saved_mesh_optimization: only if patch diagnostic supports it

candidates.purpose: correct distance-field undersampling and boundary size imbalance
candidates.distance_sampling: bucket curves by power-of-two sample count, target sample spacing<=boundary_size/2
candidates.boundary_point_size: boundary_size with MeshSizeFromPoints=1; no geometry changes
candidates.scope: small local source crops first, full fine candidate only after local all-angle and quadratic validity checks

selection: first full candidate passing every unchanged gate; no hidden tuning, threshold relaxation or geometry repair

budget.record: per-stage wall time, whole-process peak RSS, disk; enforce worker time/memory limits
budget.stop: on unsupported API, source modification, resource limit, or no passing registered strategy

solver_gate: actual compatible installation, licensed smoke, direct rectangle pass, contact rectangle pass, authentic outputs and full model review before separately frozen microstructure pilot
mechanical_convergence: UNQUALIFIED without matched actual solved levels; geometric multi-level pass never implies it
